request.input:
1girl, solo, adult woman, sacred invocation, singing softly, composed majestic expression, looking slightly down toward the viewer, one open hand reaching toward the camera, other hand lifted near her sternum

Premium legendary ability card illustration, a monumental blessing carried by wind, strong iconic silhouette.

Extreme low three-quarter camera, close medium shot cropped at upper thighs. Woman dominates center-right, foreground open palm enlarged on lower left with natural foreshortening. Long braid and deep teal cape sweep toward upper right. A huge luminous curved current rises from the lower left foreground, wraps behind her, and opens toward the upper left like a vast breaking wave. Keep her face and hands unobstructed. Dark negative space above left, asymmetrical grand composition, only one character.

Deep midnight teal and blue-black backdrop, one immense warm ivory-gold opening behind her silhouette, pale turquoise wind and sparse golden falling light. Strong chiaroscuro, narrow gold rim along cape and hair, gold eyes and face remain focal. Broad sculptural cloth folds and large luminous shapes, a few geometric flecks, high complexity, no buildings.
